# Arzen Industrial Group

> Arzen Industrial Group is a sourcing and in-person verification intermediary connecting U.S. aerospace and defense procurement teams with vetted CNC machining, tooling and structural-component manufacturers in Querétaro and Nuevo León, Mexico. Every supplier is visited and verified in person before being recommended. Arzen does not manufacture and does not hold inventory. Consulting engagements for buyers start at a fixed fee discussed on an initial call; it costs suppliers nothing to apply to the network. Founded by Andrea Canabal. Works in English and Spanish.

## Key facts
- Name: Arzen Industrial Group (short name: Arzen)
- What it does: in-person supplier verification; sourcing of CNC machined parts, tooling and fixtures, and secondary structural components; quoting, sample parts and first-order management; nearshoring from Asia to Mexico.
- Who it serves: U.S. aerospace OEMs and Tier 1/2 suppliers, defense manufacturing programs, aviation MRO, space and satellite systems (buyers); CNC, tooling and structural shops in Mexico (suppliers).
- Where: suppliers in Querétaro and Nuevo León, Mexico; buyers across the United States. Service-area business, works by appointment; no public walk-in address.
- Focus: tooling, fixtures and secondary structural components — not flight-critical prime parts that need a 12–24 month certification cycle.
- Contact: network@arzenindustrial.com · LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/arzen-industrial-group/ · reply within 1 business day.
- Not published (not claimed): street address, phone number, opening hours.

## For buyers (English)
- [Home](https://arzenindustrial.com/en/): verified CNC, tooling and structural suppliers in Mexico for U.S. aerospace and defense buyers.
- [About Arzen](https://arzenindustrial.com/en/about/): who we are, what we do, where we work, who we serve, why choose us.
- [Services](https://arzenindustrial.com/en/services/): overview of all buyer services.
- [Supplier verification](https://arzenindustrial.com/en/services/supplier-verification/): Arzen visits CNC, tooling and structural shops in Querétaro and Nuevo León, confirms equipment, tolerances and references, then matches them to your part.
- [CNC machining sourcing](https://arzenindustrial.com/en/services/cnc-machining-sourcing/): Source precision CNC machined parts from shops in Querétaro and Nuevo León that Arzen has visited and verified, matched to aerospace and defense specs.
- [Tooling and fixtures](https://arzenindustrial.com/en/services/tooling-and-fixtures-sourcing/): Source production, inspection and ground-support tooling and fixtures from verified shops in Querétaro and Nuevo León for aerospace and defense programs.
- [Structural components](https://arzenindustrial.com/en/services/structural-components-sourcing/): Source secondary structural components for aerospace and defense from verified shops in Querétaro and Nuevo León, without a long certification cycle.
- [Nearshoring (USMCA)](https://arzenindustrial.com/en/services/usmca-nearshoring-sourcing/): Move CNC, tooling and structural sourcing from Asia to verified shops in Querétaro and Nuevo León, with USMCA and tariff questions raised early.
- [Quoting and first order](https://arzenindustrial.com/en/services/quoting-sample-first-order/): Formal quoting, a physical sample part before you commit, and a managed first purchase order with verified CNC and tooling shops in Mexico.
- [Locations](https://arzenindustrial.com/en/locations/): where Arzen sources and who it serves.
- [Querétaro](https://arzenindustrial.com/en/locations/queretaro/): Source CNC machining, tooling and secondary structural components from shops in Querétaro, Mexico, visited and verified in person by Arzen.
- [Nuevo León](https://arzenindustrial.com/en/locations/nuevo-leon/): Source CNC machining and tooling from shops in Nuevo León and the Monterrey area, visited and verified in person by Arzen for U.S. buyers.
- [Guides](https://arzenindustrial.com/en/guides/): practical guides for buyers.
- [How to Vet a CNC Supplier in Mexico: A Buyer's Checklist](https://arzenindustrial.com/en/guides/vet-cnc-supplier-mexico/)
- [USMCA vs. China Sourcing: Real Cost and Lead-Time Numbers](https://arzenindustrial.com/en/guides/usmca-vs-china-sourcing/)
- [RFQ Checklist for CNC Parts Sourced from Mexico](https://arzenindustrial.com/en/guides/rfq-checklist-cnc-parts-mexico/): What to include in an RFQ for CNC machined parts so Mexican suppliers can quote accurately: drawings, tolerances, materials, volume, inspection and delivery.
- [Contact](https://arzenindustrial.com/en/contact/): request a consultation.

## Para proveedores (Español)
- [Inicio](https://arzenindustrial.com/es/): red verificada de talleres CNC, tooling y estructuras en Querétaro y Nuevo León. Sin costo por aplicar.

- [Servicios](https://arzenindustrial.com/es/servicios/)

- [Verificación de taller](https://arzenindustrial.com/es/servicios/verificacion-de-taller/): Arzen visita tu taller CNC en Querétaro o Nuevo León, confirma equipo, tolerancias y capacidad, y valida referencias para presentarte con compradores de EE. UU.
- [Conexión con compradores](https://arzenindustrial.com/es/servicios/conexion-con-compradores-de-eeuu/): Arzen presenta tu taller verificado con compradores aeroespaciales y de defensa de EE. UU. cuyas piezas encajan contigo, y te acompaña en la primera orden.
- [Ubicaciones](https://arzenindustrial.com/es/ubicaciones/)
- [Querétaro](https://arzenindustrial.com/es/ubicaciones/queretaro/): Postula tu taller CNC o de tooling en Querétaro a la red de Arzen. Visita de verificación sin costo y conexión con compradores aeroespaciales de EE. UU.
- [Nuevo León](https://arzenindustrial.com/es/ubicaciones/nuevo-leon/): Postula tu taller CNC o de tooling en Nuevo León y el área de Monterrey a la red de Arzen. Sin costo y con conexión a compradores aeroespaciales de EE. UU.

- [Cómo preparar tu taller CNC para exportar a EE. UU.](https://arzenindustrial.com/es/guias/preparar-taller-exportar-eeuu/)
